The safety plan is fully captured: client surrendering both blades, mother securing household sharps, ice-cube and cold-water alternatives, crisis contacts (988, Crisis Text Line, therapist line), and the explicit commitment to disclose emergent suicidal thoughts. The client's active interests (drawing, daily dog walks) are documented, and the mother's "lazy" characterization is not adopted as a clinical finding. All audit directives are honored.
